name: hexaploid
strain_assembly: Chinese Spring IWGSC RefSeq v2.1 — full hexaploid
key_challenge: Cross-subgenome homeolog ambiguity (~95%), full scale polyploid (17 Gb, AABBDD, 2n=6x=42)

reference.notes: VERIFY: confirm v2.1 full assembly URL at URGI before download. This is a 14.5-17 Gb download. See chr3b manifest (T8a) for a tractable contained option. Only run this target if you have confirmed appetite for the full hexaploid scale.

download.command: wget -q --show-progress 'https://wheat-urgi.versailles.inra.fr/Seq-Repository/Assemblies' -O index.html && echo 'VERIFY: inspect index.html and identify the full assembly FASTA URL, then download manually. The full hexaploid is ~14 Gb compressed.' && exit 1

simulation.command: art_illumina -ss HS25 -i ../reference/reference.fasta -p -l 150 -f 5 -rs {rng_seed} -o reads && gzip reads1.fq reads2.fq && mv reads1.fq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads2.fq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: 5x coverage for 17 Gb genome. MEI (index memory) is a primary concern here — document peak RSS carefully.

truth.simulated: art_illumina read name encodes true origin; parse with custom comparator or paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: Full hexaploid scale benchmark. Primarily useful for MEI measurement and large-genome throughput. Prefer T8a (chr3B) unless testing full-scale memory behavior. Homeolog ambiguity is identical to T8a at higher absolute volume.

curation.notes: Download command is intentionally a stub requiring manual confirmation. The 17 Gb download should be deliberate.
